select * from ( select
(IFNULL(day_plan_qty1, 0) + IFNULL(night_plan_qty1, 0)) as daily_total_qty, TRUNCATE(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0) as day_finish_qty1, case when a.day_plan_qty1=0 then null when a.day_plan_qty1!=0 then (TRUNCATE(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0)/a.day_plan_qty1) end as day_finish_rate1, TRUNCATE(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0) as NIGHT_FINISH_QTY1, case when a.night_plan_qty1=0 then null when a.night_plan_qty1!=0 then (TRUNCATE(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0)/a.night_plan_qty1) end as night_finish_rate1, b.MONTH_PLAN_QTY as month_plan, CEILING(b.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY) as month_plan_os, log.change_machine, log.change_day_plan, log.change_night_plan,
(TRUNCATE(IFNULL(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0), 0) + TRUNCATE(IFNULL(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0), 0)) AS total_finish_qty, CASE WHEN (TRUNCATE(IFNULL(a.day_plan_qty1, 0), 0) + TRUNCATE(IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty1, 0), 0)) != 0 THEN TRUNCATE((IFNULL(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0)) / (TRUNCATE(IFNULL(a.day_plan_qty1, 0), 0) + TRUNCATE(IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty1, 0), 0)), 4) ELSE 0 END AS daily_finish_rate, cr.curl_length
from t_cd15_schedule_result a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MATERIAL_CODE,MONTH_PLAN_QTY,MONTH_REMAIN_QTY FROM T_CD15_MONTH_PLAN_SURPLUS WHERE del_flag='0' and YEAR=#{year,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and MONTH=#{month,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) b on a.steel_strip_code1=b.MATERIAL_CODE LEFT JOIN T_CD15_DAY_FINISH_QTY fq on a.order_no = fq.order_no and fq.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN (/*调度员操作日志，判断调度员是否有做“转机台”或“调量”操作*/ SELECT schedule_id, max(IF(BEFORE_MACHINE_ID = AFTER_MACHINE_ID,0,1)) change_machine, max(IF(BEFORE_DAY_PLAN = AFTER_DAY_PLAN,0,1)) change_day_plan, max(IF(BEFORE_NIGHT_PLAN = AFTER_NIGHT_PLAN,0,1)) change_night_plan FROM T_CD15_DISPATCHER_LOG where schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} group by schedule_id ) log ON a.id = log.schedule_id LEFT JOIN t_cd15_curl_length cr on a.steel_strip_code1 = cr.steel_strip_code and cr.is_delete = '0' where a.del_flag='0' and a.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate,jdbcType=DATE}
and INSTR(a.big_roll_code, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and instr(concat(',',a.machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code1, #{steelStripCode1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code2, #{steelStripCode2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and a.IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.id in #{scheduleId} order by (case when instr(machine_id,',') > 0 then machine_id when machine_id is null or machine_id = '' then '0' else '-1' end) desc/*多个机台 和 没有机台的排在前面*/, a.big_roll_code,a.CUTTING_ANGLE asc ) t
order by ${orderStr}

select
fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY as day_finish_qty1, case when a.day_plan_qty1=0 then null when a.day_plan_qty1!=0 then (fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY/a.day_plan_qty1) end as day_finish_rate1,
fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY as NIGHT_FINISH_QTY1, case when a.night_plan_qty1=0 then null when a.night_plan_qty1!=0 then (fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY/a.night_plan_qty1) end as night_finish_rate1,
b.MONTH_PLAN_QTY as monthPlan,b.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY as monthPlanOs
from t_cd15_schedule_result a
LEFT JOIN ( select MATERIAL_CODE,MONTH_PLAN_QTY,MONTH_REMAIN_QTY,YEAR,MONTH from T_CD15_MONTH_PLAN_SURPLUS where del_flag='0' ) b on a.steel_strip_code1=b.MATERIAL_CODE and b.YEAR=DATE_FORMAT(a.schedule_date,'%Y') and b.MONTH=DATE_FORMAT(a.schedule_date,'%m')
LEFT JOIN T_CD15_DAY_FINISH_QTY fq on a.schedule_date =fq.schedule_date and a.steel_strip_code1=fq.STEEL_STRIP_CODE
where a.id=#{id} limit 1

INSERT INTO MES_CD15_SCHEDULE_RESULT( SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, BIG_ROLL_CODE, MACHINE_CODE, STEEL_STRIP_CODE1, SAP_MATERIAL_CODE1, STEEL_STRIP_CODE2, SAP_MATERIAL_CODE2, UNIT_CONSUME1, STOCK1_QTY1, STOCK1_QTY2, CUTTING_ANGLE, SUPPLY_TIME1, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, IS_RELEASE, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, CRAFT1, CRAFT2, REMARK, DATA_VERSION, CREATE_DATE, UPDATE_DATE, IS_DELETE, FACTORY_CODE, COMPANY_CODE ) SELECT SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, BIG_ROLL_CODE, m.MACHINE_CODE, STEEL_STRIP_CODE1, p1.BELT_SAP1, STEEL_STRIP_CODE2, p1.BELT_SAP2, UNIT_CONSUME1, STOCK1_QTY1, STOCK1_QTY2, CUTTING_ANGLE, SUPPLY_TIME1, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY1, NIGHT_PRODUCE_ORDER1, NIGHT_SYS_ANALYSIS1, NIGHT_HAND_ANALYSIS1, DAY_PLAN_QTY1, DAY_PRODUCE_ORDER1, DAY_SYS_ANALYSIS1, DAY_HAND_ANALYSIS1, CX_CLASS1_PLAN, CX_CLASS2_PLAN, CX_CLASS3_PLAN, CX_CLASS4_PLAN, CX_CLASS5_PLAN, '1', MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, r.CRAFT1, r.CRAFT2, r.REMARK, #{dataVersion} DATA_VERSION, #{createTime} CREATE_DATE, r.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_DATE, r.DEL_FLAG IS_DELETE, #{factoryCode}, #{companyCode} FROM T_CD15_SCHEDULE_RESULT r LEFT JOIN T_CD15_MACHINE_INFO m ON r.machine_id = m.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT max(BELT_SAP1) BELT_SAP1, max(BELT_SAP2) BELT_SAP2, BELT_CODE1, BELT_CODE2 FROM T_CONSTRUCTION_VERSION_INFO WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY BELT_CODE1, BELT_CODE2) p1 ON r.STEEL_STRIP_CODE1 = p1.BELT_CODE1 and r.STEEL_STRIP_CODE2 = p1.BELT_CODE2 WHERE r.id in #{id}

select ci.EMBRYO_CODE EMBRYO_CODE, /*成型排程胎胚代码，施工表的胎胚代码*/ ci.EMBRYO_VERSION as BOM_DATA_VERSION, /*成型排程胎胚版本，施工表的胎胚版本*/ CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER, CI.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC, CI.BELT_CUTTING_ANGLE, CI.BELT_CODE1, CI.BELT_CODE2, CI.CORD_SPEC, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_LENGTH1 SIDEWALL_LENGTH, ci.BEAD_TYPE, ci.BEAD_ARRANGE, /*排列*/ ci.DIMENSION, /*寸口*/ ci.TIRE_RING_CODE, /*胎圈代码*/ ci.BEAD_CODE, /*钢丝圈代码*/ ci.APEX_CODE, /*三角胶代码*/ ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_CODE, /*胎圈胶料代码*/ ci.HEXAGON_MOUTH_PLATE, /*胎圈口型板*/ ci.HEXAGON_RUBBER_DIMENSION, /*胎圈尺寸*/ ci.INSIDE_CODE, /*内衬代码*/ ci.INSIDE_RUBBER, /*内衬胶料代码*/ ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH, /*内衬长*/ CI.ID, CI.PRODUCTION_STAGE from T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci where 1=1 AND ci.DEL_FLAG = 0
AND ci.embryo_code IN
#{code}
and (ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0' or ci.PRODUCTION_STAGE is null)

SELECT SUM(night_plan_qty1) as night_plan_qty FROM t_cd15_schedule_result a WHERE a.schedule_date = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
and INSTR(a.big_roll_code, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and instr(concat(',',a.machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code1, #{steelStripCode1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code2, #{steelStripCode2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and a.IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT IFNULL(CEILING(sum((IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER / 1000)), 0) cxConsumeQty FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ WHERE cxr.schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and INSTR(ci.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(ci.BELT_CODE1, #{steelStripCode1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(ci.BELT_CODE2, #{steelStripCode2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0

SELECT
ci.BELT_CODE1 as steelStripCode1,
ci.BELT_CODE2 as steelStripCode2,
IFNULL(CEILING(sum((IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER / 1000)), 0) cxConsumeQty FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/ WHERE cxr.schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and INSTR(ci.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(ci.BELT_CODE1, #{steelStripCode1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(ci.BELT_CODE2, #{steelStripCode2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
AND ci.BELT_CODE1 IS NOT NULL AND ci.BELT_CODE1 IN
#{code}
AND ci.BELT_CODE2 IS NOT NULL AND ci.BELT_CODE2 IN
#{code}

SELECT a.steel_strip_code1, SUM(night_plan_qty1) as lastMidPlanQty, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty1, 0) / IFNULL(b.curl_length, c.param_value)), 1) as lastMidPlanQtyRollNum FROM t_cd15_schedule_result a left join t_cd15_curl_length b on a.steel_strip_code1 = b.steel_strip_code and b.is_delete = '0' left join t_cd15_params c on c.del_flag = '0' and c.param_code = 'CRIMP_LENGTH' WHERE a.del_flag = '0' and a.schedule_date = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND a.steel_strip_code1 IS NOT NULL
and INSTR(a.big_roll_code, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and instr(concat(',',a.machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code1, #{steelStripCode1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code2, #{steelStripCode2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and a.IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY a.steel_strip_code1

SELECT a.steel_strip_code2, SUM(night_plan_qty1) as lastMidPlanQty, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty1, 0) / IFNULL(b.curl_length, c.param_value)), 1) as lastMidPlanQtyRollNum FROM t_cd15_schedule_result a left join t_cd15_curl_length b on a.steel_strip_code1 = b.steel_strip_code and b.is_delete = '0' left join t_cd15_params c on c.del_flag = '0' and c.param_code = 'CRIMP_LENGTH' WHERE a.schedule_date = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND a.del_flag = '0' and a.steel_strip_code2 IS NOT NULL
and INSTR(a.big_roll_code, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and instr(concat(',',a.machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code1, #{steelStripCode1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code2, #{steelStripCode2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and a.IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY a.steel_strip_code2
